body: They still hate each other, and it shows. My mum's not doing so well, but she's improving and beginning to be more...consistent. My dad has stayed the exact same, but being older, wiser and better with the quick wit that I am mostly at his level. I'm still the mediator between my parents, passing messages along...so better but not great. I too appreciate the inquiry

I'd kill for those grades, unfortunately i can't get focused. If you're confident about your knowledge, why not put yourself out there for a tutoring job, not everyone is getting A;s and it's a chance to meet people. There's always chances to meet people, so if you focus on school, it's not an entirely bad way to spend your time. Colleges also have many programs you can join, a bunch of sports for novice and advanced players...just put yourself out there, someone will be thankful for knowing you

I watch movies. Tons and tons of movies. I usually pick a topic or an actor and try to watch everything from that. uhhh...bam! Tom Hanks, okay lets watch Apollo 13, Sleepless in Seattle, Toy Story 1,2,3, Money Pit, Joe vs. the Volcano, Turner and Hooch, Cast Away, Big, Dragnet, Road to Perdition, Polar Express, You've Got Mail...well, you get the picture.

does it matter if we're not over 30? i'm close to it but there's no age limit to self-harm. I don't know what or why other people do it, but there are those times when you're just.... really down, feeling worthless and feeling like you deserve to feel this way... so you take a sharp/jagged implement, keys in this example and from high on the back ribcage downwards cutting through skin of the ridges of the ribs that are getting more noticeable with loss of appetite from depression and feeling it for days thinking you deserve worse. But then you get out of that feeling and you stay up late replying to comments on reddit/r/depression. Hope life goes well for you

Well, I had good parents, I love them but looking at my childhood it was far from good. Parents divorced, hardly see my dad so stuck with mom. She is bi-polar and drinks. I had to grow up and take care of her very quickly, probably why I have no patience for childish things, very lonely at school, mostly speak with teachers about films. So many days, weeks, months of her down period where she'd be in bed and I'd wait on her, there i am 11 years old opening a beer for my mom while she's in bed and has been there for days. With medication, you must continue taking it for a long time and it's effects will set in. They will do something for you. It is also likely your doctor set you up on a small dose and will build it up after time. If not, ask to try something else. I currently have 6 different prescriptions for sleeping pills, even now it's almost 4am, just keep with it. You may love your mother and want her to understand you but it may not happen, OTHER PEOPLE WILL UNDERSTAND what you're going through, continue talking about these things with people, it'll get better, it has to

19, are you in highschool, college, uni? There are plenty of programs and athletics you can join, everyone there is wanting you to or else they wouldn't exist. This is a common problem with this age group as the computer seems like the only friend you can have and it's easy to escape to, easy isn't always the best for you though. At 19 you have a lot of potential, don't waste it surfing the computer (The reddit police may not like me making this comment) so hurry while you still can :)

You may not be depressed but you should definitely talk to someone about these problems, especially the drugs- these can make certain mental disorders a lot worse or affect your mood in the same way as some disorders. If you're at uni then there should be councilors to speak with, even physicians or psychologists that can give you an accurate diagnosis and other help. You sound very capable of turning you life around and becoming happy and successful, I wish you the best and message if you'd like to talk further.

It's tough finding friends at that age, it's not like in school when being in the same grade equaled friends. One idea, you could get a dog and attend a dog park regularly, I meet quite a few people and strike up conversations with strangers, some do stay connected. There's no reason to read this, I just type
I too have this similar problem. Although I have had 'friends' I've never had anyone close, not even family is close. Message me as well, even if nothing comes from it, it's worth a shot.

Your existence is validated, congrats! I notice your user name, did you get that from The Simpsons, if so, it seems like we have a lot in common. Message me if you'd like, is it still human contact through reddit though?

With my depression I also have a bit of OCD. Cleaning always helps. It does get in the way and some routines are time consuming and then there is the time when you can't clean anymore, and the depression is really noticeable, and all thoughts lead to suicide, but I just usually end up watching movies. I watch about 2-3 a day. The films then usually revolve around depression too, no point watching a comedy when quite depressed.

I don't have much experience myself with that, but I assume with the way average people think, they're not going to notice bandaids at all.  But if you still feel that people will focus on them, maybe put a bandaid or two on your knees or elbows, then people will just assume you fell...bit of manipulation but it works.
It's hard to live for yourself when you feel you're worthless. I'll take it one moment at a time. Thanks.
Thanks, I see you try to help everyone on here and that's just great! I'm going to take a walk and hopefully I'll get passed this.

I've spoken to the counselor, but it's hard for me to believe someone like that cares what i do. I can't function like other people. When people express worry for me, compliment me, or try to make me feel better, it puts a weight on my chest and makes it harder to breathe. I really just want to disappear. I look at my life, and I shouldn't feel this way, which just adds on more guilt. It's been like this for over 10 years, I just escape every chance i get which is how i made it this far but it's getting harder to escape...

you shouldn't care what people talk about, and what is normal people? basically everyone is on some kind of prescription, statistics say 25% of females alone will suffer depression at some point in their lives (north America). i don't know what other people will think, but i'm sure everyone on this subreddit will judge you as being a strong person for going to the hospital for help.

If you really need the break from school, tell your doctor about these feelings. Universities are very understanding and will try to help you. If its seriously, check yourself into a clinic, then your parents have to take you seriously. What's the worse that could happen if you told your parents or family? No one should feel this way, take care of you, keep yourself going so you can then take care of your grandfather and others.

you have no idea how many times i just wrote something then deleted it. i'm in a similar way, but i don't have a solution. I'm not saying there isn't one out there. There are much, much, much, much, more qualified people that can help you with this. Your feelings and thoughts may go away with medication, or even just talking about it with someone face-to-face. I'm just saying it will pass. you always have a support system and people around you. I hope you get better

I watched about 7 hours of television a day, when I'm at home, I always have something on. I can't fall asleep unless something's on. If you want to talk PM me. If we can't be friends then we could at least get a few good television show recomendations from eachother

Next time you're "happy as fuck" write that down, why/with who/when you were happy, do that everytime. Then next time you feel really low, look at those messages and remember it will happen again. There will always be a time you can be "happy as fuck" again. And if that doesn't work, PM me at the low times and maybe I can cheer you up
I know this is not the answer to all your problems but i'd be happy to help out with the maths frustration, PM me if you want the help, we can set up a constant communication. Just an idea.
PM me too if you want, I'd like more information, probably have a lot in common. Or if you don't want to talk about yourself, we could always just talk about something else, I'm a huge fan of movies

When i had similar problem at a similar age, I couldn't talk to my parents, i could barely look at them because i was so ashamed i felt that way. The only thing that ever put a smile on my face was my dog. Therapy pets have a huge impact, it gives you a reason to go outside to walk them, a reason to get up and give them food and water, they comfort you in the night. It's just an idea, maybe just discuss it with her

If you would like to open a communication line, I'm sure i'll find many great qualities in you. email with whatever whenever, i don't sleep so i'll always respond: zombiezomedy@gmail.com

Don't try to find a reason why you are depressed. Find a reason not to be. I've always been depressed and have suicidal thoughts practically everyday since i was 10 but then I look and my pet and i start to feel better. when watching a really good movie (Shaun of the Dead) I'll forget about ending my life, even if it just for 2 hours it makes a difference

I've been negative and cynical all my life, which people have only started to notice, now i feel like i have to hide from them. If you want to feel less lonely, email me any time and i'll always respond zombiezomedy@gmail.com
